text:
Rae: FYI CS flagged tenants seeing v1 billing during v2 SDK rollout. Missing x-rw-version header seems to be the cause.
Ming: We default to v1 when header absent. For rollouts we should offer per-tenant "prefer-latest-on-missing" toggle.
Cole: Minimal mitigation: short-lived routing override for affected tenants (treat missing as v2) with probe weight and fallback-on-error.
Rae: Need telemetry split: requested_version vs routed_version and version_source (explicit|implicit|pin|global) so CS can reconcile.
Ming: Console copy: "Routing preference only. Billing shows requested vs routed until policy changes."
Cole: Safety: start probe 20% implicit->v2, sample 2k pairs, auto-rollback if v2 implicit 5xx rate > baseline*3 or similarity < 0.8.
infra-bot: deploy: routing-override-tenant started by Cole - probe=20% window=60m
Rae: Action items: Cole -> short override; Ming -> telemetry + dashboard slice; Rae -> coordinate with CS.
console-bot: Draft banner: "Missing client version header? Enable tenant preference to be routed to v2 during SDK rollout. This affects routing only; billing will display requested vs routed versions."
Cole: Will push small PR for override and fallback rule. Thanks.
